p: waters: That is, be liberal to the poor, and though it seems to be as a thing ventured on the sea, yet it will bring you profit.
clouds are full of rain: As the clouds that are full pour out rain, so the rich that have abundance must distribute it liberally.
tree falleth toward the south: He exhorts to be liberal while we live: for after, there is no power.
wind shall not sow: He who fears inconveniences when need requires will never do his duty.
withhold not thy hand: Be not weary of well doing.
that: That is, which of your works are most agreeable to God.
darkness: That is, of affliction and trouble.
Rejoice: He derides them who set their desire in worldly pleasures as though God would not call count.
sorrow from thy heart: That is, anger and envy.
put away evil from thy flesh: Meaning, carnal lusts to which youth is given.
